# Moritz Schlick

*1882 – 1936 · German · [Logical positivism](../movements/logical-positivism.md)*

German philosopher trained as a physicist, founder of the Vienna Circle, whose seminar he led from 1924. He saw the clarification of meaning as philosophy's proper task; he was murdered by a former student in 1936.
